stories.title: Airbus to create 480 jobs in £150m Broughton wing plant conversion
stories.summary: Airbus is investing £150 million to convert its former A380 wing production line at Broughton into a new facility building wings for the A321. stories.title: Mold theatre to stage A Doll’s House, The Secret Garden and new Lucie Lovatt thriller
stories.summary: Theatr Clwyd in Mold has announced its spring 2027 season, featuring three new productions. stories.title: North Wales Police visit 56 children in month-long online safety operation
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s Online Child Abuse Investigation Team carried out 56 visits to children and family members during August as part of a month-long safety operation.
